traits.name: Magic Sense
traits.text: (primal); The leydroth detects the source and school of each source of magic within 60 feet as an imprecise sense.

traits.name: Menace to Magic
traits.text: ⬲ (abjuration, primal); Trigger A creature within 60 feet Casts a Spell Effect The leydroth attempts an Intimidation check to counteract the triggering spell.

traits.name: Dispelling Roar
traits.text: ⬺ (abjuration, auditory, emotion, fear, mental, primal); The leydroth unleashes a bestial roar that reverberates within a 30-foot emanation. It rolls an Intimidation check and compares the result to the Will DC of each creature in the area, with the effects of Demoralize. It also uses this result to attempt to counteract each spell or magical effect in the area, plus one item or effect on each creature in the area, with the effects of dispel magic. The leydroth can't use Dispelling Roar again for 1d4 (1d4) rounds.

traits.name: Dispelling Strike
traits.text: ⭓ (abjuration, primal); Frequency once per round Trigger The leydroth hits a creature, object, or spell effect with a Strike Effect The leydroth casts its innate dispel magic, targeting one effect on the creature struck.

traits.name: Spell Feedback
traits.text: (primal); Any time a leydroth counteracts a spell or item, the spell's caster or the creature holding the item takes 8d6 (8d6) mental damage (DC 38 basic Will save).
